events.title: Guerre d'agression menée par la Russie contre l'Ukraine: l'UE restreint le commerce avec 15 entités liées au complexe militaro-industriel russe
events.context: Le Conseil a imposé des mesures restrictives à 15 entités russes pour leur rôle dans le complexe militaro-industriel russe et leur soutien à celui-ci dans le contexte de la guerre d'agression menée par la Russie contre l'Ukraine.

events.title: Sanctions de l'UE contre le terrorisme: le Conseil inscrit sur la liste le fondateur de "The Base"
events.context: Le Conseil élargit sa liste de sanctions afin de lutter contre le terrorisme en désignant le fondateur et le dirigeant de l'organisation "The Base", sanctionnée par l'UE.

events.title: Budget de l'UE pour 2027: le Conseil donne son feu vert définitif
events.context: Le Conseil a donné son feu vert définitif sur le budget annuel de l'UE pour 2027, le septième et dernier budget annuel de l'actuel cadre financier pluriannuel (CFP) 2021-2027.

events.title: Trade-facilitating measures help offset rise in new G20 trade restrictions
events.context: The number of tariff increases and other non-facilitating trade measures introduced by G20 economies rose sharply in the first half of 2026, and the stockpile of such measures reached a record level, according to the WTO's latest report on G20 trade measures. At the same time, G20 economies, representing around 80-85 per cent of global GDP and 75 per cent of international trade, introduced a significant number of trade-facilitating measures, helping to reinforce global trade flows despite heightened geopolitical tensions and economic uncertainty.

events.title: EU launches safeguard investigation into certain composite input materials
events.context: On 23 November 2026, the European Union notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated, on the same day (23 November 2026), a safeguard investigation into imports of certain composite input materials.

events.title: 2026 APEC Leaders’ Declaration - Shenzhen Outlook: Building an Asia-Pacific Community to Prosper Together
events.context: We, the Economic Leaders of APEC, gathered in Shenzhen, China, on November 18 to 19, 2026. events.title: Sommet UE–Royaume-Uni à Bruxelles
events.context: L’Union européenne et le Royaume-Uni ont publié une déclaration commune à leur deuxième sommet. Ils ont réaffirmé leur engagement à appliquer l’accord de retrait.

events.title: Accord provisoire sur les importations d’énergies fossiles et le méthane
events.context: Le Conseil de l’UE et le Parlement européen ont annoncé un accord provisoire reportant de deux ans certaines obligations liées au méthane. Le report couvre des importations de gaz naturel, de pétrole brut et de charbon. L’adoption formelle constitue une étape distincte.

events.title: Durabilité: le Conseil et le Parlement parviennent à un accord sur la simplification des règles de transparence pour les produits financiers
events.context: Le Conseil et le Parlement européen sont parvenus à un accord provisoire sur la simplification des règles de transparence pour les produits financiers durables vendus dans l'UE.

events.title: Prime Minister Carney strengthens economic partnerships at APEC, capping an ambitious week that delivered major gains for Canadian workers and businesses
events.context: Canada is moving strategically, pragmatically, and decisively to secure greater access to new markets and attract new investment – building our strength at home and diversifying our partnerships abroad. To these ends, the Prime Minister, Mark Carney, represented Canada this week at the 33 rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Economic Leaders’ Meeting, in Shenzhen, China. There, APEC leaders outlined a shared vision for the Asia-Pacific to remain the world’s most dynamic and interconnected region. Prime Minister Carney emphasised the importance of predictable trade, resilient supply chains, and deeper economic integration in driving investment, innovation, and shared prosperity across the region. events.title: Panama submits request to join Expansion of the Information Technology Agreement
events.context: Panama has submitted a request to join the 2015 Expansion of the Information Technology Agreement (ITA II), the Chair of the Committee of Participants on the Expansion of Trade in Information Technology Products, Mr Shih-Chun Weng of Chinese Taipei, informed members at a meeting on 19 November. Panama said joining ITA II will help it to advance its goal of a more knowledge-based, innovation-driven and technologically advanced economy.

events.title: Prime Minister Carney advances Canada’s strategic partnership with China across trade, commerce, and culture
events.context: Over the past year and a half, Canada’s government has recalibrated our relationship with China – strategically, pragmatically, and decisively. Last January, the Prime Minister, Mark Carney, and the President of the People’s Republic of China, Xi Jinping, launched a new Canada-China strategic partnership to stabilise trade, build out clean energy industries, and better connect our peoples. Under the partnership, Canada and China have strengthened economic and financial cooperation, expanded cultural exchanges, and reduced tariffs on Canadian exports of canola seed and meal, peas, crab, and lobster. To date, Canada has restored market access for more than 90% of trade previously subject to tariff action – nearly $7.5 billion worth of Canadian exports. events.title: New trade-restrictive measures surge but WTO members step up trade facilitation efforts
events.context: The pace of newly-introduced tariffs and other non-facilitating measures rose sharply in the first half of 2026, while the stockpile of such measures reached a record level, according to the WTO Director-General's latest annual overview of developments in the international trading environment. At the same time, WTO members introduced a significant number of trade-facilitating measures, helping to sustain global trade flows despite heightened geopolitical tensions and economic uncertainty.
